request.query: A polynomial evaluation homomorphism maps polynomials of degree m to polynomials of degree at most m*n

items.name: MvPolynomial.aeval_natDegree_le
items.type:
∀ {σ : Type v} {R : Type u_2} [inst : CommSemiring R] {m n : ℕ} (F : MvPolynomial σ R),
  F.totalDegree ≤ m →
    ∀ (f : σ → Polynomial R), (∀ (i : σ), (f i).natDegree ≤ n) → ((MvPolynomial.aeval f) F).natDegree ≤ m * n

items.name: MvPolynomial.IsHomogeneous.aeval
items.type:
∀ {σ : Type u_1} {τ : Type u_2} {R : Type u_3} {S : Type u_4} [inst : CommSemiring R] [inst_1 : CommSemiring S]
  {φ : MvPolynomial σ R} {m n : ℕ} [inst_2 : Algebra R S],
  φ.IsHomogeneous m →
    ∀ (g : σ → MvPolynomial τ S), (∀ (i : σ), (g i).IsHomogeneous n) → ((MvPolynomial.aeval g) φ).IsHomogeneous (n * m)

items.name: Polynomial.aeval
items.type:
{R : Type u} →
  {A : Type z} → [inst : CommSemiring R] → [inst_1 : Semiring A] → [inst_2 : Algebra R A] → A → Polynomial R →ₐ[R] A

items.name: MvPolynomial.IsHomogeneous.eval₂
items.type:
∀ {σ : Type u_1} {τ : Type u_2} {R : Type u_3} {S : Type u_4} [inst : CommSemiring R] [inst_1 : CommSemiring S]
  {φ : MvPolynomial σ R} {m n : ℕ},
  φ.IsHomogeneous m →
    ∀ (f : R →+* MvPolynomial τ S) (g : σ → MvPolynomial τ S),
      (∀ (r : R), (f r).IsHomogeneous 0) →
        (∀ (i : σ), (g i).IsHomogeneous n) → (MvPolynomial.eval₂ f g φ).IsHomogeneous (n * m)

items.name: Polynomial.degree_map_le
items.type:
∀ {R : Type u} {S : Type v} [inst : Semiring R] [inst_1 : Semiring S] {f : R →+* S} {p : Polynomial R},
  (Polynomial.map f p).degree ≤ p.degree
